Game Overview

Doomsday Survival Rpg Shooter puts players into a shooter experience centered on lead survivors in a thrilling post-apocalyptic 2D world as you scavenge amidst the undead. Strategically manage time and resources to complete quests and fend off zombies. Swift decisions and teamwork are crucial as you navigate a city teeming with danger and opportunity, ensuring your group lives another day.
